name: 정밀 여과기
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a staged equipment sprite sheet for a tiny cozy witch-shop game. True transparent alpha background. Strict chunky hard-square pixel art, dark plum #432039 stepped outline, antique gold metalwork #efc77c, ivory highlights, muted violet wood and sage accents, 4 flat shade clusters. Every object fully visible, front view, same scale and base y within each cell, generous empty margins, no overlaps, no text, lettering, digits, floor, cast shadow, glow, blur or background scene. Objects should remain readable in 32x40 logical pixels per cell. EXACT 2 columns and ONE row of equal-sized cells. Subject is a gold funnel with ivory filter paper on a plum stand above a mint glass collection flask. Left cell: IMPROVED version with two plum vertical support pillars and gold valve collar. Right cell: PREMIUM version with double gold funnel rim, lavender central gemstone, gold base corners, same funnel-to-flask silhouette. These are new upgraded variants; original basic design stays in a separate asset. All variants retain the same core function and silhouette family, with clearly stronger gold framing at each stage. Do not use extra floating badges or place text anywhere.
